```{r setup}
create_dt <- function(x){
    DT::datatable(x,
                extensions = 'Buttons',
                options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                buttons = list('copy', 'csv', list(extend = 'excel', title = NULL), 'pdf', 'print'),
                               # buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                               pageLength = 10,
                                lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                    c(10,25,50,"All")),
                paging = TRUE
                ),
                filter = "top"
  )
}

colorPalette_08 = c("#2271B2","#F748A5","#359B73","#F0E442","#D55E00","#3DB7E9","#E69F00","#000000")
colorPalette_12 = c("#E20134","#00FCCF","#008DF9","#8400CD","#FFC33B","#9F0162","#009F81","#FF5AAF","#FF6E3A","#00C2F9","#FFB2FD","#A40122")
colorPalette_15 = c("#F60239","#003C86","#EF0096","#9400E6","#009FFA","#008169","#68023F","#00DCB5","#FFCFE2","#FF71FD","#7CFFFA","#6A0213","#008607","#00E307","#FFDC3D")

# commonly used functions
`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
is.notna <- function(x) {
  return(!is.na(x))
}
# tuning parameters
cell_w <- 0.25   # inches per column
cell_h <- 0.25   # inches per row

# Render a plotting call to a PDF and return a self-contained "Download PDF"
# button (the PDF is embedded as a base64 data URI so it survives
# embed-resources: true -- no external files are written next to the report).
# `expr` is evaluated lazily while the pdf device is open, so pass the plotting
# call unquoted, e.g. pdf_download_button(print(p), "p.pdf", 8, 6, "My plot").
pdf_download_button <- function(expr, filename, width, height, label = filename){
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
  grDevices::pdf(tmp, width = width, height = height)
  tryCatch(force(expr), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
  uri <- paste0("data:application/pdf;base64,", base64enc::base64encode(tmp))
  unlink(tmp)
  htmltools::tags$a(
    href = uri,
    download = filename,
    class = "btn btn-primary btn-sm",
    style = "margin: 4px;",
    htmltools::HTML(paste0("&#11015; ", label, " (PDF)"))
  )
}

```

```{r}
targets = readr::read_tsv("regions/bed_withGeneInfo.tsv", col_names = T)
targets_aaInfo = readr::read_tsv("regions/bed_withGeneAAInfo.bed", col_names = T)
```

```{r}
targets_name_key = targets %>%
  mutate(new_target_name = case_when(
    is.na(ID) ~ name,
    is.na(Name) ~ paste0(name, "-", ID),
    T ~ paste0(name, "-", Name)
  )) %>%
  select(name, new_target_name)
```



```{r}
seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed.tab.txt") %>%
  left_join(targets_name_key %>%
              dplyr::rename(target = name))

label_nudge_samples <- 0.0125 * max(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed$nSamples)
label_nudge_haps <- 0.0125 * max(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed$totalHaplotypes)

seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed_samplesGatheredPerTarget_plot = ggplot(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed,
                                                                     aes(x = new_target_name, y  = nSamples)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = nSamples
            ),
        nudge_y = label_nudge_samples

    ) +
    labs(y = "Total Samples")+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0))


seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed_totalHapsGatheredPerTarget_plot = ggplot(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed,
  aes(x = new_target_name, y  = totalHaplotypes)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = totalHaplotypes
            ),
        nudge_y = label_nudge_haps

    ) +
    labs(y = "Total Haplotypes") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0))
n_targets <- dplyr::n_distinct(seqsPerTargetGatheredDetailed$new_target_name)
plot_w_px <- max(c(700, n_targets * 20))   # 35 px per bar is a decent start

```


```{r}
allBasicInfo = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allBasicInfo.tab.txt.gz")%>%
  left_join(targets_name_key )

allBasicInfo = allBasicInfo |>
    group_by(sample) |>
    mutate(medianCov = median(perBaseCoverage)) |>
    mutate(covNorm = ifelse(medianCov > 0, perBaseCoverage/medianCov, 0))


allBasicInfo_sp = allBasicInfo |>
    select(sample, new_target_name, covNorm) |>
    spread(new_target_name, covNorm)

allBasicInfo_sp_mat = as.matrix(allBasicInfo_sp[,2:ncol(allBasicInfo_sp)])
rownames(allBasicInfo_sp_mat) = allBasicInfo_sp$sample
allBasicInfo_sp_mat[allBasicInfo_sp_mat > 10] = 10
allBasicInfo_sp_mat_hp = Heatmap(
    allBasicInfo_sp_mat,
    name = "Normalized Coverage",
    row_dend_width = unit(4, "cm"),
    column_dend_height  = unit(2, "cm")
)

allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp = allBasicInfo |>
    select(sample, new_target_name, perBaseCoverage) |>
    mutate(perBaseCoverage = log10(perBaseCoverage + 1)) |>
    spread(new_target_name, perBaseCoverage)

allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat = as.matrix(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp[,2:ncol(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp)])
rownames(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat) = allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp$sample
allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat[allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat > 10] = 10
allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat_hp = Heatmap(
    allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat,
    name = "log10\nCoverage",
    row_dend_width = unit(4, "cm"),
    column_dend_height  = unit(2, "cm")
)

# coverage heatmaps also carry a row dendrogram (4 cm) + row labels + legend,
# so widen the per-column size and add headroom beyond the raw column count
cov_cell_w <- 0.5
coverage_fig_w <- max(10, ncol(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat) * cov_cell_w + 4)
coverage_fig_h <- max(6, nrow(allBasicInfo_logRawCov_sp_mat) * cell_h * 1.5)



```



```{r}
div_measures = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/popGenetics/allDiversityMeasures.tsv.gz") %>%
  left_join(targets_name_key %>%
              dplyr::rename(target = name))
div_measures_sel = div_measures |>
    select(-expShannonEntropy, -avgPercentID, -avgNumOfDiffs, -simpleAvalance, -completeAvalance)
```


```{r}
allSelectedClustersInfo = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allSelectedClustersInfo.tab.txt.gz") %>%
  left_join(targets_name_key %>%
              dplyr::rename(p_name = name))

# HaplotypeRainbows v2.0.0: the package is now a single chainable R6 class.
# The column mapping is supplied once to $new(); this data uses SeekDeep names
# (the target column was renamed to new_target_name above).
allSelectedClustersInfo_rb = HaplotypeRainbows::HaplotypeRainbow$new(
  allSelectedClustersInfo,
  sample_col    = "s_Sample",
  target_col    = "new_target_name",
  popuid_col    = "h_popUID",
  rel_abund_col = "c_AveragedFrac"
)
allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$prep()
if(n_distinct(allSelectedClustersInfo$s_Sample) > 1){
  allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$sort_samples_by_clustering()
}
allSelectedClustersInfo_plot = allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$plot()

# count-driven figure sizing (width scales with targets, height with samples)
allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_dims = allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$dims(
  cell_width = cell_w, cell_height = cell_h
)
allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_fig_w = allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_dims$width
allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_fig_h = allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_dims$height


```


```{r}
min_target_coverage = 0.80
min_target = 20
min_cum_freq = 0.98

allSelectedClustersInfo_target_coverage = allSelectedClustersInfo %>%
  group_by(new_target_name) %>%
  summarise(sample_count = n_distinct(s_Sample)) %>%
  mutate(sample_freq = sample_count/n_distinct(allSelectedClustersInfo$s_Sample))

allSelectedClustersInfo_target_coverage_filt = allSelectedClustersInfo_target_coverage %>%
  filter(sample_freq > min_target_coverage)


allSelectedClustersInfo_filt = allSelectedClustersInfo %>%
  filter(new_target_name %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_target_coverage_filt$new_target_name)

allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi = allSelectedClustersInfo_filt %>%
  group_by(s_Sample, new_target_name) %>%
  summarise(COI = n_distinct(h_Consensus))

allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_sum = allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi %>%
  group_by(s_Sample, COI) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  mutate(freq = n/total) %>%
  arrange(s_Sample, COI) %>%
  mutate(cum_freq = cumsum(freq))

allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_sum_filt = allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_sum %>%
  filter(cum_freq >= min_cum_freq)

allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_coi_offset = allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi %>%
  group_by(s_Sample) %>%
  arrange(COI) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rank != max(rank)) %>%
  group_by(s_Sample) %>%
  summarise(naive_COI_2nd_max_method = max(COI))

allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_sum_filt_COI = allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_sum_filt %>%
  group_by(s_Sample) %>%
  summarise(naive_COI_freq_method = min(COI)) %>%
  left_join(allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_coi_offset) %>%
  left_join(allSelectedClustersInfo_filt %>%
              group_by(s_Sample) %>%
              summarise(total_target = n_distinct(new_target_name))) %>%
  bind_rows(allSelectedClustersInfo %>%
              select(s_Sample) %>%
              filter(s_Sample %!in% allSelectedClustersInfo_filt_coi_sum_filt$s_Sample))

```

```{r}
#| title: Known mutations within sample info table

if(file.exists("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")){
  AAChangesInfo = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")

  AAChangesInfo_targeted = AAChangesInfo %>%
    filter(Targeted == "Yes") %>%
    filter(AA_cnt > 0) %>%
    select(-Gene_Transcript_ID, -ExonicFunc, -Mutation_Name, -CoveredBy, -Targeted)
  create_dt(AAChangesInfo_targeted)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: Known mutations frequency and prevalence table

AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_fig_w = 10
if(file.exists("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")){
  AAChangesInfo = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")

  AAChangesInfo_targeted_population = AAChangesInfo %>%
    filter(Targeted == "Yes") %>%
    filter(AA_cnt > 0) %>%
    select(Gene_ID, Gene, AA_Change, reference_AA_pos, reference_AA, AA, is_reference, AlleleCount, AlleleFrequency, SampleCount, SamplePrevalence) %>%
    unique()
  AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_fig_w = n_distinct(paste0(AAChangesInfo_targeted_population$Gene_ID, "-", AAChangesInfo_targeted_population$reference_AA_pos))
  create_dt(AAChangesInfo_targeted_population)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: Known mutations prevalence plot
#| fig-width: !expr AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_fig_w

if(file.exists("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")){
  AAChangesInfo = readr::read_tsv("PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")

  AAChangesInfo_targeted= AAChangesInfo %>%
    filter(Targeted == "Yes") %>%
    filter(AA_cnt > 0) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID, reference_AA_pos, sample) %>%
    mutate(genotype = case_when(
      all(!is_reference) ~ "alt",
      all(is_reference) ~ "ref",
      T ~ "mixed"
    ))
  AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_genotype_count = AAChangesInfo_targeted %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID, reference_AA_pos) %>%
    mutate(position_sample_total = n_distinct(sample)) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID, reference_AA_pos, position_sample_total, genotype) %>%
    summarise(sample_count = n_distinct(sample)) %>%
    mutate(sample_prev = sample_count/position_sample_total) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID) %>%
    mutate(Identifier = paste0(Gene, "-", Gene_ID, "-", stringr::str_pad(reference_AA_pos, max(nchar(reference_AA_pos))))) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplotly(ggplot(AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_genotype_count) +
    geom_col(aes(x = Identifier, y = sample_prev, fill = genotype, sample_count = sample_count), color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorPalette_08))
}
```
